_doc: Coaching copy, keyed by coaching_id. {delta} is the signed delta vs the reference median, {unit} its unit, {profile} the selected reference's label. Copy states only the measured delta; it never invents a number.

presence_high.title: Too much presence
presence_high.explanation: The 3-4 kHz region sits {delta} {unit} above the {profile} reference, which can sound harsh or nasal.

presence_low.title: Not enough presence
presence_low.explanation: The 3-4 kHz region sits {delta} {unit} relative to the {profile} reference, so the vocal may sound dull or buried.

boxiness_high.title: Boxy low-mids
boxiness_high.explanation: The 250 Hz region is {delta} {unit} above the {profile} reference, which sounds boxy or muddy.

sibilance_high.title: Harsh 's' sounds
sibilance_high.explanation: 5-9 kHz energy is {delta} {unit} above the {profile} reference, so 's' and 't' sounds may stick out.

plosive_detected.title: Plosive pops
plosive_detected.explanation: There are {delta} {unit} more low-frequency pops than the {profile} reference typically shows.

noise_floor_high.title: Noisy recording
noise_floor_high.explanation: The background noise is {delta} {unit} above the {profile} reference.

clipping_present.title: Clipping
clipping_present.explanation: {delta} {unit} of samples are clipped, more than the {profile} reference. Clipping is distortion that cannot be removed afterwards.

lufs_over.title: Louder than the reference
lufs_over.explanation: Overall loudness is {delta} {unit} above the {profile} reference.

lufs_under.title: Quieter than the reference
lufs_under.explanation: Overall loudness is {delta} {unit} relative to the {profile} reference.

lra_wide.title: Level swings too much
lra_wide.explanation: The loudness range is {delta} {unit} wider than the {profile} reference, so some words will be too quiet or too loud.

true_peak_hot.title: Peaks run hot
true_peak_hot.explanation: True peaks are {delta} {unit} above the {profile} reference, leaving little headroom.

crest_low.title: Possibly over-compressed
crest_low.explanation: The peak-to-average gap is {delta} {unit} relative to the {profile} reference, which suggests heavy compression.
